_meta.description: Integration run of the SPMD-macro benchmark ports, joined with the ISPC reference manifest (ispc-ref/BASELINES.json). rustlane_ms = best (min-of-N) whole-benchmark time measured by each Rust bench binary in THIS integration session; ispc_x8_ms/ispc_x4_ms/serial_ms copied from BASELINES.json. ALL ms values are PROVISIONAL: measured on Apple Silicon NEON under concurrent CPU load; final evaluation re-measures. Every port validated against ispc-ref/ref-out/*.bin and exited 0.
_meta.platform: Apple Silicon aarch64 / NEON, rustlane N=8 (neon-i32x8-equivalent)
_meta.build: cargo build --workspace --release: GREEN. cargo test --workspace: GREEN (24 suites, 140 tests, 0 failed; incl. new math::tests::fma_matches_scalar_mul_add and memory::tests::inactive_lanes_never_touch_memory).
_meta.post_opt_verification: POST-OPT, STILL PROVISIONAL. Post-optimization verification sweep of two optimizer changes: gather/scatter scalar-bounds fast path in rustlane-core/src/memory.rs, and fma-contraction in rustlane-core/src/math.rs + rustlane-bench/src/bin/options.rs. Build+tests GREEN. All six benches run sequentially (nothing else running), each printed OK / exit 0. CROSS-CHECKS HELD: rt bit-exact (max_rel 0.000e0, 0/810000, checksum 7.1449470502e8); volume output BIT-IDENTICAL to pre-opt (CHECKSUM 109129.841793 unchanged across 2 runs, checksum_rel 2.681e-8, max_rel 8.978e-4, 0/1060864); options binomial now BIT-EXACT (max_rel 0.000e0 <= 2.43e-7 gate). No validation regression on any bench (all checksums unchanged: mandelbrot 27304085, bs sum 13102023, binomial sum 12344328, stencil checksum_rel 1.088e-10, ao 365243.449219). rustlane_ms values below are each binary's internal min-of-N, best-of-N across a few back-to-back runs, still under residual concurrent load; final eval re-measures. Only change of note: volume improved ~8.4% (2396.126 -> 2195.949 ms); binomial recorded value dropped 34.011 -> 32.999 under lighter load (fma change is a fidelity win, small microarch regression vs pre-fma base per optimizer); untouched kernels (mandelbrot/stencil/ao/rt) flat within load noise.
_meta.fidelity_review: Adversarial fidelity+perf review pass applied 3 fixes and re-measured (still under concurrent load): (1) options binomial_put: restored the in-loop `/ disc` division (the port had strength-reduced it to a hoisted reciprocal multiply; ISPC's binary does a real fdiv.4s per tree step) — max_rel vs .bin improved 1.70e-6 -> 2.43e-7; (2) ao: restored the full occlusion-ray Isect bookkeeping (t/p/n + vnormalize) that the ISPC binary performs in the AO sample loop (port had hit-only kernels); output checksum identical (365243.449219), time 158.5 -> ~191 ms, still ~2.05x ahead of ISPC x8; (3) volume driver: 5 -> 15 timed reps to match bench_volume.cpp. rustlane_ms values below updated accordingly.

mandelbrot.note: Self-validates against its own natural-port checksum 27304085 (does not load the .bin); ISPC .bin checksum is 27303781, diff 304/27.3M = 1.1e-5, within boundary-divergence tolerance. Frozen reference example. rustlane 12.27ms is ~1.19x ahead of ISPC neon-i32x8 (14.578ms). export==direct checksum. POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): kernel untouched by either optimization; direct 12.265ms / export 12.348ms best-of-4, checksum 27304085 unchanged, export==direct, OK.

black_scholes.note: BIT-EXACT vs options_bs.bin: max_rel=0.000e0, 0/131072 mismatches, our BS sum 13102023.000000 == ISPC 13102023.000000. Sub-millisecond kernel; review-pass best of repeated runs 0.5165ms matches ISPC x8 (0.5241ms). Earlier 0.92ms reading was contention jitter. POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): unchanged (not on the fma path); best-of-5 0.5160ms (a lone 0.9231ms sweep read was again sub-ms contention jitter), bit-exact held, OK.

binomial_put.note: FMA-CONTRACTION FIX (spec 14.5): tree step now uses explicit `math::fma(1-Pu, V[k], Pu*V[k+1]) / disc`, matching ISPC's fmul+fmla+fdiv emission. objdump-confirmed: inner loop is now 2 fmul + 2 fmla + 2 fdiv per N=8 step (was 4 fmul + 2 fadd + 2 fdiv). FIDELITY WIN: now BIT-EXACT vs options_binomial.bin -- max_rel improved 2.43e-7 -> 0.000e0, 0/131072 mismatches, binomial sum 12344328 == ISPC 12344328 exactly. PERF (honest): contrary to the pre-change 10-15% gain expectation, best-of-15 REGRESSED ~5% under a controlled back-to-back interleave (same concurrent load): base 32.42ms vs fma 34.01ms. Asm-verified cause: the loop is fdiv-throughput-bound (2 fdiv.4s/step, unchanged both ways), so dropping 8 FP ops/step to 6 buys nothing, while the fma serializes after its feeding fmul (fmla latency ~= fmul on Apple Silicon) where the old code ran two independent fmuls in parallel into a cheaper fadd -- the mul->fma serialization plus concentration onto the FMA/divide-shared pipes costs a little. Now ~24% behind ISPC neon-i32x8 (27.35ms), still under the 25% gate. Fidelity gate (improve-or-hold) satisfied; timing-gain expectation not met on this microarch. PROVISIONAL under concurrent load; final eval re-measures. POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): fidelity gate re-CONFIRMED bit-exact (VALIDATE binomial max_rel=0.000e0, 0/131072, sum 12344328 == ISPC), well under the 2.43e-7 gate; best-of-5 timing 32.999ms (< the 34.011 recorded under the optimizer's heavier interleave, so no additional regression observed here), OK, exit 0.

options.note: One bench, two kernels timed separately (BASELINES.json 'options' block). serial_ms is combined for both kernels. Post-fma overall CHECKSUM 25446351 == ISPC 25446351 exactly (was 25446354, rel 1.2e-7): binomial is now bit-exact after the fma-contraction fix. Program exits 0.

stencil.note: fma-tolerance vs stencil.bin: checksum_rel=1.09e-10, max_abs=4.43e-5, 11947669/16777216 bit-exact, all halo cells bit-exact. Divergence is pure reference-side fma contraction over 6 iterations (proven: a non-fma scalar recompute is byte-identical to this kernel; an fma scalar recompute matches the .bin). Memory-bound; rustlane 92.5ms is ~1.11x ahead of ISPC neon-i32x8 (102.732ms). POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): kernel untouched by either optimization; validation BYTE-IDENTICAL to pre-opt (bit_exact 11947669/16777216, max_abs 4.435e-5, checksum_rel 1.088e-10), OK. Timing best-of-4 94.866ms vs 92.456 recorded = +2.6%, within memory-bound load variance (observed 94.866-96.902 across runs), NOT a code regression; re-measure on a quiet machine.

volume.note: vs volume.bin (serial ground truth): checksum_rel=2.68e-8, max_rel=8.98e-4, max_abs=6.62e-5, 0/1060864 mismatches. Review fix: driver now 3 warmup + min-of-15 reps matching bench_volume.cpp (was min-of-5). ~21% behind ISPC neon-i32x8 (1979.82ms), under the 25% gate. Density-gather-bound; asm-confirmed residual gap: the safe gather materialises a per-gather vector bounds mask (sshll/cmhi/uzp1/addv, ~14 instrs) plus 8 guarded ld1.s lane loads, where ISPC reuses its exec mask; ISPC also pays guarded lane loads, so the delta is the bounds-mask computation. POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): gather fast-path optimization (rustlane-core/src/memory.rs) landed. Output BIT-IDENTICAL to pre-opt -- CHECKSUM 109129.841793 (was 109129.841793) reproduced across 2 runs, VALIDATION line unchanged (ref_checksum 109129.838867, checksum_rel 2.681e-8, max_rel 8.978e-4, max_abs 6.615e-5, 0/1060864), confirming the optimizer's bit-identical claim. Timing best-of-2 2195.949ms vs 2396.126 recorded = ~8.4% faster (gap to ISPC neon-i32x8 1979.82ms narrows to ~10.9%), OK.

ao.note: FIDELITY FIX applied by review: occlusion rays now run the full sphere/plane Isect bookkeeping (nearest-t + hit point + normal + vnormalize) exactly as ao.ispc does (ISPC's compiled AO loop keeps that work; the port had hit-only kernels). Output checksum IDENTICAL pre/post fix (365243.449219) proving the shortcut was output-equivalent; time 158.5 -> 191.2ms. Statistical gate PASSED: 0.0224% rel err vs ao_ispc.bin (gate 0.1%; ISPC x8 itself is 0.018% off by the same per-width RNG-stream mechanism). rustlane 191.2ms is ~2.05x AHEAD of ISPC neon-i32x8 (392.771ms); remaining legitimate structural differences: 2-D foreach!+uniform u/v loops instead of ISPC's 4-D foreach_tiled (v1 library has no 4-D form; lanes map to distinct pixels so plain stores replace ISPC's atomic_add_local). POST-OPT (post-opt, still provisional): scatter fast-path (rustlane-core/src/memory.rs) touches this bench's store sites; output checksum UNCHANGED (365243.449219, 0.0224% rel err vs ao_ispc.bin), OK. Timing best-of-4 192.564ms vs 191.184 recorded = +0.7%, flat within load noise, no regression.
